name: forester-edit
description: Keybound structural insertions (\li, \ol, \p, \tag, person links) plus build and touch-date commands for Forester .tree files

commands.title: Forester: Insert \li{} after the cursor's item in the innermost \ul{}/\ol{}
Forester: Insert \li{} one list out from the innermost (fresh \ul{} at end of tree if none)
Forester: Insert \li{} in a fresh \ul{} at the end of the tree
Forester: Insert \ol{\li{}} (nested in the current item, else after the cursor's line)
Forester: Insert \ul{\li{}} (nested in the current item, else after the cursor's line)
Forester: Insert [[@person]] from trees/people (or create one)
Forester: Insert [[@]] with the cursor after the @
Forester: Append \p{} at end of the subtree or tree

forestEdit.buildCommand.description: Command run by "Forester: Build Forest", in the workspace folder of the active tree.

forestEdit.author.description: Value of \author{} written into person trees created by "Insert [[@person]]".

forestEdit.touchDateCommand.description: Command run by "Forester: Touch Date"; receives the active file's path as its only argument.
